# Koma Miko — Skill checks for Claude Code and Codex

> Miko (npm: koma-miko) is a local, open-source verifier for required Skill reads,
> proposed tool actions, and completion evidence. Its current focus is Claude
> Code and Codex CLI. The verifier makes no LLM calls.

## When Miko helps

Use Miko when a coding agent attempts a protected edit without observable reads
of the project's required Skills or references. Project-owned miko.json Agent
Specs define the checks. Missing evidence pauses the applicable action and gives
the agent a recovery instruction. Observed reads do not prove comprehension or
compliance. Native host permissions remain authoritative.

A small native Hook may be enough for one fixed check. Miko adds shared Spec
configuration, evidence tracking, post-compaction reload requirements, recovery
messages, and completion checks. It cannot verify events the host never exposes.

## Start with your host

Install in the project: npm install -D koma-miko@alpha

- Claude Code: npx koma-miko init --host claude
  Edit miko.json to name existing Skills and protected paths; start a new session.
  Check configuration with npx koma-miko doctor --host claude --strict.
- Codex CLI (Technical Preview): npx koma-miko init --host codex --enforce
  Edit miko.json, open Codex CLI in the project, run /hooks, review and trust the
  five Miko Hooks, then run one turn. Check activation with
  npx koma-miko doctor --host codex --strict.
  Codex Desktop requires prior CLI activation. Review mode degrades to pause/deny.

The initializer does not install Skills or replace an existing miko.json.
An offline probe checks adapter logic, not live host activation.
Try npx --yes koma-miko@alpha demo for a deterministic replay without an API key.

## Current documentation

- Miko README and host support: https://github.com/swnotmetal/Project-Koma/blob/main/packages/koma-miko/README.md
- Chinese README: https://github.com/swnotmetal/Project-Koma/blob/main/packages/koma-miko/README.zh-CN.md
- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/koma-miko
- Browser replay (simulation, no installation): https://koma-demo.swbuilds.workers.dev
- Claude evaluation: https://github.com/swnotmetal/Project-Koma/blob/main/docs/evals/miko-claude-haiku-alpha.md
- Codex and other host evaluation history: https://github.com/swnotmetal/Project-Koma/blob/main/docs/evals/miko-host-adapters-alpha.md

Evaluation records are dated, narrow observations, not general reliability scores.
Gemini is outside active development. Copilot adapter work is paused pending real
tester availability. DeepSeek Harness remains a separate experimental adapter.
Existing adapters do not imply equal support across hosts.

## Other Koma packages

These work independently and are not required to use Miko:

- koma-gate: semantic input classification before an application's model call.
  https://github.com/swnotmetal/Project-Koma/blob/main/packages/koma-gate/README.md
- koma-scout: rate limiting, audio validation, and geographic request rules.
  https://github.com/swnotmetal/Project-Koma/blob/main/packages/koma-scout/README.md
- koma-core: separate public search metadata from token-gated content retrieval.
  https://github.com/swnotmetal/Project-Koma/blob/main/packages/koma-core/README.md

Gate and Core have separate MCP servers. Miko uses host Hooks and has no MCP
server in the current alpha. All Koma packages are MIT licensed.
